newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's bullish Morococha jumps 10.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's bullish Morococha jumps 10.3 pct.

text.p: Peruvian polymetallic miner Morococha's labor stock extended its bull run to rally 10.3 percent in early trading Thursday on the Lima Stock Exchange.
Morococha was spurred on by strong metal prices and healthy investment and growth projections, traders said. The stock also gained 10.2 percent in Wednesday's session.
By 1030 local time/1530 GMT, the share was trading at 4.88 soles after opening at 4.43 soles, the Lima bolsa said.

"Morococha has made this fresh gain because the market is enthused by the rises in zinc prices, and for the additional factor of the entry as a partner of Phelps Dodge," said Miguel Bondy, of JPBT brokerage.
Morococha announced last week that Phelps Dodge had bought a 27 percent stake in the firm. That news has brought expectations of increased investment and profitability.
Peruvian mining stocks have been on a bullish run since the start of the year, rising 104 percent, according to the Lima Stock Exchange.
